app.name: Chorus
app.tagline: Work with several coding agents in one conversation, on your own machine.

conversation.projectPathPlaceholder: Leave empty to start in your home folder
conversation.readOnlyNotice: Agents start read-only. They ask before running or changing anything.
conversation.placeholder: Say something. Type @ to choose who answers.
conversation.steer: Send — the agent keeps working and takes this in
conversation.addAgent: Bring {{agent}} in — it reads the conversation so far
conversation.nobodyHere: Nobody is in this conversation. Add an agent to start again.
conversation.restartLabel: Start this session over, with nothing said in it
conversation.endConfirm: An agent is working — press again to end this session

workspace.empty: No session is open in the editor
workspace.emptyHint: Choose a running session from the sidebar.
workspace.closePane: Close editor group — sessions keep running
workspace.endConfirm: An agent is still working. End this session?

settings.heading: Settings
settings.paneNote: Agents, folder and permissions belong to each session — change them in its own bar. A new session starts where the last one was.
settings.newSessionsNote: A default only. Each conversation can change its own from its card in the sidebar.

policy.heading: What agents may do without asking
policy.footnote: Anything a profile does not cover still asks. Slack, Jira and the like always ask.

logs.heading: What Chorus has been doing
logs.redactedHint: Secrets are removed as the log is written.
logs.exportHint: Writes a shareable file to your Desktop.

summary.heading: What happened in this session
summary.noAgentWork: No agent has taken a turn yet.
summary.source: Counted from the log. What is missing and what is next are questions for an agent.

review.heading: Changes on disk
review.untrackedOnly: Only untracked files — nothing to diff yet.
review.source: Read from git, not from the transcript.

handoff.heading: Hand off
handoff.title: {{from}} → {{to}}
handoff.previewHint: Edit anything here before it is sent.
handoff.editedHint: Edited — this is what will be sent.

ide.heading: VS Code context
ide.include: Include this selection with your message

status.unmatched: No file from this project is open
status.untrusted: This workspace is restricted in VS Code
status.ambiguous: Several VS Code windows have this project
status.tooLarge: Selection is too large to send

error.tooLarge: That selection is too large to send. Select less, or exclude the editor context.
error.unavailable: Could not read the editor selection ({{reason}}). Your message was not sent.

ide.openProject: Open this project in VS Code

openError.cli-missing: VS Code's `code` command is not on your PATH. In VS Code, run "Shell Command: Install 'code' command in PATH".
openError.open-failed: VS Code could not open this folder.
openError.unknown: VS Code could not open this folder.

extension.title: VS Code extension
extension.missing: VS Code's `code` command is not on your PATH, so Chorus cannot install the extension for you.
extension.none: Not installed. Chorus can install the bundled version for you.
extension.outdated: Version {{installed}} is installed; this build ships {{bundled}}.
extension.done: Installed. Reload the VS Code window to start using it.
extension.unavailable: This build of Chorus does not ship the extension.

context.title: Context window {{percent}}% full — the agent compacts when it fills

history.heading: Past conversations
history.empty: Nothing here yet. Conversations appear once something is said in them.
history.note: Reopening starts its agents again. They read the transcript before answering, and permissions return to Read only.

plan.label: Plan
plan.enter: Plan only — read and reason, change nothing until the plan is approved
plan.leave: Stop planning and return to ordinary permissions

mcp.heading: MCP servers
mcp.note: These come from your own Claude configuration. A server that needs authenticating gives its agent no tools, and says nothing about it.
